entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not bad. Your Persona's pretty powerful.
entries.uk: Непогано. Твоя Персона досить сильна.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Persona...?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Y'mean that thing that comes outta you[n]guys all dramatic-like?
entries.uk: Ти про ту штуку, що так ефектно[n]з вас вилазить?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yes. You saw how Frizzy Hair here ripped[n]off his mask when he summoned it, right?
entries.uk: Так. Ти ж бачив, як Кучерявий зірвав[n]маску, коли її викликав?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, everybody wears a mask deep within[n]their heart. By removing that...
entries.uk: Розумієш, кожен носить маску глибоко[n]в серці. Знявши її...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Wait, when did you lose your mask!?[n]Your clothes are back to normal, too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, it looks like you don't have full[n]control over your power yet.
entries.uk: Хм, схоже, ти ще не повністю[n]контролюєш свою силу.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The transformation shouldn't normally[n]dissolve like that. After all—
entries.uk: Зазвичай перетворення не мало б[n]отак розсіюватися. Зрештою...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Rrgh, that's enough! This crap doesn't[n]make any sense!
entries.uk: Гр-р, годі! Ця маячня не має[n]жодного сенсу!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Actually, there's no time for me to[n]lecture you!
entries.uk: Власне, нема часу читати[n]тобі лекції!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You wanna escape this place in one piece,[n]right? Let's go!
entries.uk: Ти ж хочеш вибратися звідси цілим,[n]так? Ходімо!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, but before that—take these.[n]Use them carefully, okay?
entries.uk: О, але спершу — візьми ось це.[n]Використовуй обережно, гаразд?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, we should hurry. It's not much[n]farther to the exit.
entries.uk: Ну ж бо, треба поспішати. До виходу[n]вже недалеко.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Will you give me a second here!?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: That's our volleyball team's[n]uniform...right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, let's go.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Hold on, dammit!
entries.uk: Стривай, чорт забирай!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Hey, if we're able to escape, can we take[n]them with us?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: They're probably from our school.[n]You know where the exit is, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What are you saying? If we don't[n]get moving—

entries.speaker: Armored Soldier
entries.en: There!
entries.uk: Ось вони!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You should've listened to me...!
entries.uk: Треба було мене слухати...!

entries.en: Let's fight.
entries.uk: Б'ємося.

entries.en: Let's run away.
entries.uk: Тікаймо.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Raring for a fight, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like they are, too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sure, if it lets us...
entries.uk: Звісно, якщо нас пустять...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like that's not an option.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right! Let's get away before more[n]show up!
entries.uk: Гаразд! Тікаймо, доки[n]не з'явилося більше!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Hold on, we can't just leave these guys[n]here!
entries.uk: Стривай, ми не можемо просто кинути[n]цих людей тут!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You really don't get it, do you?[n]Hrgh... There's no time to explain.
entries.uk: Ти справді нічого не тямиш, так?[n]Гр-р... Нема часу пояснювати.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look, I'm going. If you don't want to[n]follow, be my guest!
entries.uk: Слухай, я йду. Не хочеш[n]іти за мною — прошу дуже!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Dammit... Fine, I'm coming!
entries.uk: Чорт... Гаразд, іду!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This one should work the same as last[n]time. I think that statue will do the trick.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Good. You've shown a lot of promise here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go, Blondie!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Wait up! We ain't the only ones who[n]got caught in here, right!?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: I mean the guys in the cells're kids from[n]our school...

entries.speaker: Soldier's Voice
entries.en: We have escapees!

entries.speaker: Soldier's Voice
entries.en: The guard captain is off assisting[n]King Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Soldier's Voice
entries.en: Everyone else, find the escapees.[n]Kill them if they try to resist!

entries.speaker: Soldier's Voice
entries.en: And increase the security!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This isn't good! The Shadows are starting[n]to get agitated.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, do you want to die here!?[n]Stop wasting time and let's go!
